summary.headline: Cyient Q2 FY27: DET revenue $174.2M (+7.5% QoQ, +6.3% YoY cc) and EBIT margin 14.2%, highest in 10 quarters; organic growth only 1.6% QoQ.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 showed DET revenue of $174.2M including one month of TAO Digital (about $9.6M), with organic DET revenue of $164.5M up 1.6% QoQ and 0.4% YoY in constant currency. Record Q2 order intake of $158.4M (up nearly 21% YoY) excludes a €50M-per-year frame agreement with a consumer goods major. EBIT margin rose to 14.2%, aided by cost optimisation and billing days, and DET free cash flow reached Rs.214 Cr. Management flagged a wage hike in Q3 and Q4, a deferred semiconductor breakeven (still FY28), and softer near-term semiconductor growth on supply constraints.

segments.name: Transportation & Mobility
segments.commentary: Grew 4.5% QoQ and 16.5% YoY in constant currency, the sixth consecutive quarter of growth, driven mainly by aerospace aftermarket and automotive.

segments.name: Networks & Infrastructure
segments.commentary: Flattish at -0.3% QoQ cc and +1% YoY, reflecting completion of project engagements and weakness in utilities; portfolio reshaping announcements expected soon.

segments.name: Strategic Markets
segments.commentary: Declined 1.5% QoQ in constant currency; management says energy is at the bottom and should grow, and the strategic markets mix is roughly 65% energy/process, 22% HLS and the rest mining & minerals.

segments.name: DLM
segments.commentary: Revenue grew more than 26% YoY in INR; order book at a record high with book-to-bill above 1.6x; H1 revenue more than 30% above H1 last year.

segments.name: Semiconductor
segments.commentary: Revenue $19.3M (+8% QoQ); EBIT loss reflects product R&D investment, with core custom ASIC business described as cash generative; custom ASIC order intake up over 50% QoQ and pipeline above $100M.

guidance_outlook: No formal revenue guidance; management expressed confidence in H2 FY27 growth, which excludes TAO Digital.
Wage hikes in two phases across Q3 and Q4, with roughly equal P&L impact; cost optimisation expected to hold margins at current levels and support expansion through FY27.
Remains committed to the margin expansion roadmap from Investor Day, subject to no major exchange rate surprises.
Semiconductor breakeven remains targeted for FY28, possibly deferred a quarter or two due to supply constraints; high-voltage chip tape-out early next year with substantial revenue during FY28.
TAO Digital run-rate expected about $100M a year now, with next 12 months possibly $100-110M (rough estimate, pending Q3 data).
Frame agreement (up to €50M annually) to ramp over one to two years, with some ramp in H2 FY27; SOWs will be included in order intake as booked.
capex_capacity: Semiconductor high-voltage ASSP: process wafers and probe test flows qualified; first customer samples expected toward end of 2026 or early 2027.
Low voltage portfolio available via Kinetic acquisition; further investment ongoing.
Acquisition of TAO Digital: $218M total price, $130M upfront plus two-year performance earn-out; about $120M external commercial borrowing at SOFR-linked rate with 5-year interest rate swap.
Group headcount about 19,500, including roughly 3,000 added from TAO Digital.
Rs.720 Cr buyback (6.4 million shares) completed during the quarter; interim dividend of Rs.12 per share declared.
demand_pricing: Semiconductor: AI-driven demand strong (industry growing about 30% YoY per management), but foundry capacity constrained, raising wafer prices and pressuring margins near term; memory shortage affecting consumer and edge AI end demand, so some softening in growth pace expected.
Ambition of 70:30 mix of annuity to project revenue in DET; management estimates the company is 20-30 percentage points away.
Order intake mix: net new business in the mid-30s percentage of order intake.
Top 5 and top 10 accounts declined QoQ; management called this an aberration, while account count is falling as a long tail is rationalised.
Hedge book about $70M at average rate of about 95.6 for next 12 months; roughly 50% of net hedge covered; hedges run for up to four quarters.

qa_highlights.question: What share of DET revenue is sticky annuity and what is the target?
qa_highlights.answer: Target is 70:30 annuity to project mix; management estimates it is about 20-30 percentage points away and expects to get there relatively soon.

qa_highlights.question: Why is the €50M framework agreement excluded from order intake, and when will it ramp?
qa_highlights.answer: It is a framework agreement without signed commitment; SOWs will be booked into order intake when signed. Ramp takes one to two years, with some ramp-up in H2 FY27.

qa_highlights.question: What is the TAO Digital run-rate and growth outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Acquired at about $80M run-rate, now close to $100M; next 12 months could be $100-110M, a rough estimate pending Q3 results.

qa_highlights.question: Will TAO margins be similar to DET?
qa_highlights.answer: At EBIT level after intangibles, interest and earn-out effects, margins are very close to Cyient's; at EBITDA level they are materially higher.

qa_highlights.question: How will wage hikes affect margins in H2?
qa_highlights.answer: Two-phase hikes over Q3 and Q4 with roughly equal impact; cost optimisation gives visibility to hold margins at current levels and grow through the year.

qa_highlights.question: Semiconductor breakeven timeline and near-term growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Breakeven still targeted for FY28, possibly deferred a quarter or two; slowdown is supply-driven rather than demand-driven, with high-voltage chip revenue expected during FY28.

risks_watch: Organic DET growth only 1.6% QoQ and 0.4% YoY cc; H2 confidence depends on the frame agreement and pending deals.
Commercial aviation headwind from oil prices and the Middle East war; scenario analysis shows aerospace and automotive growth exposed to a downturn.
Semiconductor supply constraints, rising wafer and memory costs; EBIT losses continue due to product R&D; breakeven could slip.
Wage hikes in Q3 and Q4 and FX movements could pressure margins despite cost optimisation.
Declining client and account counts; top 5 and top 10 accounts ramped down in Q2.
Interest costs from the $120M acquisition debt and an earn-out liability; mining and minerals portfolio still being reworked.
summary.management_tone: Confident on margins, order intake and H2 growth, but cautious on Semiconductor near-term growth and evasive on specific numbers (no guidance, deferred annuity and TAO specifics). Management stresses that the Q2 rebound was faster than expected.
key_quotes: The EBIT loss this quarter reflects entirely our investment in product R&D.

We recorded highest ever Q2 order intake of $158.4 million, up nearly 21% year-over-year, with positive momentum across both new businesses in existing and new customers from an order intake perspective.
The breakeven timeline remains intact. We will breakeven somewhere in FY 2028.
We are back with a renewed leadership team.
